I want to inspect how audio works in a Linux folder, possibly using the SoLoud audio engine. I'll look into the linux/ or lib audio controller for that. It sounds like using commands like `rg` could be useful for browsing through folders, especially for shuffling or navigating next and previous tracks. There’s a lot to explore here, so I’ll dig into these options to figure out the best approach!
